Reads a Data Map node's maps from its files and turns them into the Lua the node runs: mapping.lua, each map's code and the helper modules, with the code each rule becomes, what to do about each generated file in the node (write it, or leave a hand edit alone), and the checks on each map. Nothing is read from disk, written or run - the caller sends the files and saves what it writes.
